title.zh: 卷一百一十九 載記第十九 姚泓
title.raw: 卷一百一十九 載記第十九 姚泓 Volume 119 Records 19: Yao Hong

units.zh: 道濟固壘不戰，紹乃攻其西營，不克，遂以大眾逼之。
units.en: Tan Daoji stayed behind walls; Yao Shao stormed his west camp, failed, then massed against him.
units.literal: Daoji kept firm ramparts and did not fight; Shao then attacked his western camp, did not take it, then pressed with the great host.

units.zh: 道濟率王敬、沈林子等逆沖紹軍，將士驚散，引還定城。
units.en: Tan Daoji led Wang Jing, Shen Linzi, and others in a straight charge at Shao's army; Shao's officers and soldiers were startled and scattered and drew back to Dingcheng.
units.literal: Daoji led Wang Chong, Shen Linzi and others to charge straight at Shao's army; officers and soldiers startled and scattered, drew back to Dingcheng.

units.zh: 紹留姚鸞守險，絕道濟糧道。
units.en: Yao Shao left Yao Luan to choke Tan Daoji's supply line.
units.literal: Shao left Yao Luan guarding the narrows, cutting Daoji's grain road.

units.zh: 時裕別將姚珍入自子午，竇霸入自洛穀，眾各數千人。
units.en: Liu Yu's columns entered from Ziwu and Luogu valleys.
units.literal: At the time Liu Yu's separate general Yao Zhen entered from Ziwu, Dou Ba entered from Luogu, each several thousand.

units.zh: 泓遣姚萬距霸，姚彊距珍。
units.en: Yao Hong sent Yao Wan and Yao Qiang to meet them.
units.literal: Hong sent Yao Wan to block Ba, Yao Qiang to block Zhen.

units.zh: 姚鸞遣將尹雅與道濟司馬徐琰于潼關南，為琰所獲，送之劉裕。
units.en: Yin Ya was captured by Xu Yan and sent to Liu Yu.
units.literal: Yao Luan sent general Yin Ya against Daoji's major Xu Yan south of Tong Pass; Ya was seized by Yan and sent to Liu Yu.

units.zh: 裕以雅前叛，欲殺之。
units.en: Liu Yu meant to execute Yin Ya for past treason.
units.literal: Yu because Ya had formerly rebelled, wished to kill him.

units.zh: 雅曰：「前活本在望外，今死寧不甘心。
units.en: Yin Ya said: "You spared me once; now I will not beg like a coward.
units.literal: Ya said, "Formerly living was already beyond expectation; now death surely I do not willingly accept.

units.zh: 明公將以大義平天下，豈可使秦無守信之臣乎！」
units.en: You claim to conquer by virtue—do not kill the one Qin man who keeps faith!"
units.literal: The enlightened lord will use great righteousness to pacify the realm—how can you make Qin lack a faithful subject!"

units.zh: 裕嘉而免之。
units.en: Liu Yu admired him and let him live.
units.literal: Yu praised him and spared him.

units.zh: 泓遣給事黃門侍郎姚和都屯于堯柳，以備田子。
units.en: Yao Hong posted Yao Hedou at Yaoliu against Shen Tianzi.
units.literal: Hong sent attendant gentleman Huangmen Yao Hedou to camp at Yaoliu to prepare for Tianzi.

units.zh: 姚紹謂諸將曰：「道濟等遠來送死，眾旅不多，嬰壘自固者，正欲曠日持久，以待繼援耳。
units.en: Yao Shao told his generals: "Jin hugs its walls waiting for reinforcements.
units.literal: Yao Shao said to the generals, "Daoji and others have come from afar to deliver death; their hosts are not many; hugging ramparts and self-fortifying—they only wish to prolong days and months to await follow-up relief.

units.zh: 吾欲分軍還據閿鄉，以絕其糧運，不至一月，道濟之首可懸之麾下矣。
units.en: Send a column to Wenxiang to sever their supplies and Tan Daoji's head will be on your pole within a month.
units.literal: I wish to divide the army and return to hold Wenxiang to cut their grain transport—within not one month, Daoji's head can hang beneath the banner.

units.zh: 濟等既沒，裕計自沮。」
units.en: Kill Tan Daoji and Liu Yu loses his spear point."
units.literal: Once Ji and others are gone, Yu's plan will naturally be blocked."

units.zh: 諸將咸以為然。
units.en: The generals agreed.
units.literal: All generals all thought it right.

units.zh: 其將胡翼度曰：「軍勢宜集不可以分，若偏師不利，人心駭懼，胡可以戰！」
units.en: Hu Yidu objected: "Split the army and one defeat routs every heart—you cannot fight divided."
units.literal: His general Hu Yidu said, "Army momentum ought to be gathered and cannot be divided; if a partial army is not successful, human hearts will be terrified with alarm—how then can we fight!"

units.zh: 紹乃止。
units.en: Yao Shao dropped his plan to split the army.
units.literal: Shao then desisted.

units.zh: 薛帛據河曲以叛。
units.en: Xue Bo rebelled from the river bend.
units.literal: Xue Bo occupied the river bend in revolt.

units.zh: 紹分道置諸軍為掎角之勢，遣輔國胡翼度據東原，武衛姚鸞營于大路，與晉軍相接。
units.en: Yao Shao spread his wings: Hu Yidu on the east plain, Yao Luan on the main road, pressing Jin.
units.literal: Shao divided roads and set various armies in horn-and-flank posture, sent General Who Supports the State Hu Yidu to hold the eastern plain, Martial Guard Yao Luan to camp on the great road, connecting with the Jin army.

units.zh: 沈林子簡精銳銜枚夜襲之，鸞眾潰戰死，士卒死者九千餘人。
units.en: Shen Linzi night-attacked; Yao Luan fell with nine thousand men.
units.literal: Shen Linzi picked crack troops, held mouthpieces for a night raid; Luan's host broke in battle and died; more than nine thousand soldiers died.

units.zh: 姚贊屯於河上，遣恢武姚難運蒲阪穀以給其軍，至香城，為王師所敗。
units.en: Yao Zan tried to ship grain from Puban but Jin smashed the train at Xiangcheng.
units.literal: Yao Zan camped on the river, sent General Who Restores Might Yao Nan to transport Puban grain to supply the army; reaching Xiangcheng, he was defeated by the royal army.

units.zh: 時泓遣姚諶守堯柳，姚和都討薛帛於河東，聞王師要難，乃兼道赴救，未至而難敗，固破裕裨將于河曲，遂屯蒲阪。
units.en: Yao Chen raced to save Yao Nan, missed him, but beat a Jin column in the bend and held Puban.
units.literal: At the time Hong had sent Yao Chen to guard Yaoliu, Yao Hedou campaigned against Xue Bo in Hedong; hearing the royal army was intercepting Nan, they hurried by combined roads to rescue; before arriving Nan was defeated, yet they broke Liu Yu's lieutenant at the river bend, then camped at Puban.

units.zh: 姚贊為林子所敗，單馬奔定城。
units.en: Yao Zan fled alone to Dingcheng after Shen Linzi routed him.
units.literal: Yao Zan was defeated by Linzi, alone on horseback fled to Dingcheng.

units.zh: 紹遣左長史姚洽及姚墨蠡等率騎三千屯于河北之九原，欲絕道濟諸縣租輸。
units.en: Yao Shao sent Yao Qia to Jiuyuan to choke Tan Daoji's supply convoys.
units.literal: Shao sent left chief clerk Yao Qia and Yao Moli and others leading three thousand horse to camp at Jiuyuan north of the He, wishing to cut off Daoji's county rent convoys.

units.zh: 洽辭曰：「夫小敵之堅，大敵之擒。
units.en: Yao Qia refused: "A small force that stands stubborn becomes bait.
units.literal: Qia declined, saying, "The firmness of a small enemy is the great enemy's catch.

units.zh: 今兵眾單弱，而遠在河外，雖明公神武，然鞭短勢殊，恐無所及。」
units.en: We are too few and too far—even you cannot stretch a whip across the river."
units.literal: Now the troops are few and weak and far beyond the river—though the enlightened lord is divinely martial, yet the whip is short and the power situation unequal—I fear there is no reaching them."

units.zh: 紹不聽。
units.en: Yao Shao ignored him.
units.literal: Shao did not listen.

units.zh: 沈林子率眾八千，耍洽於河上，洽戰死，眾皆沒。
units.en: Shen Linzi destroyed Yao Qia on the riverbank.
units.literal: Shen Linzi led eight thousand hosts, intercepted Qia on the river; Qia died in battle, the host all perished.

units.zh: 紹聞洽等敗，忿恚發病，托姚贊以後事，使姚難屯關西，紹嘔血而死。
units.en: Yao Shao died of rage and bleeding after Yao Qia's loss.
units.literal: When Shao heard Qia and others were defeated, anger and vexation brought illness; he entrusted later affairs to Yao Zan, sent Yao Nan to camp west of the pass; Shao vomited blood and died.

units.zh: 泓以晉師之逼，遣使乞師于魏。
units.en: Yao Hong begged Northern Wei for aid against Jin.
units.literal: Because the Jin army pressed, Hong sent envoys begging troops from Wei.

units.zh: 魏遣司徒、南平公拔拔嵩，正直將軍、安平公乙旃眷，進據河內，遊擊將軍王洛生屯於河東，為泓聲援。
units.en: Wei sent Minister of Education Duke of Nanping Baba Song, Straight General Duke of Anping Yizhan Juan, and Raiding General Wang Luosheng to occupy Henei and Hedong as support for Yao Hong.
units.literal: Wei sent Minister of Education Duke of Nanping Baba Song, Straight General Duke of Anping Yizhan Juan, and Raiding General Wang Luosheng; they advanced to occupy Henei, and Wang Luosheng camped in Hedong, as sounding support for Hong.

units.zh: 劉裕次於陝城，遣沈林子率精兵萬餘，越山開道，會沈田子等於青泥，將攻堯柳。
units.en: Liu Yu halted at Shan city and sent Shen Linzi with more than ten thousand crack troops over the mountains to join Shen Tianzi and others at Qingni, intending to attack Yaoliu.
units.literal: Liu Yu halted at Shan city, sent Shen Linzi with more than ten thousand crack troops to cross mountains opening roads, join Shen Tianzi and others at Qingni, planning to attack Yaoliu.

units.zh: 泓使姚裕率步騎八千距之，泓躬將大眾繼發。
units.en: Yao Hong marched with Yao Yu to meet them.
units.literal: Hong sent Yao Yu with eight thousand foot and horse to block them; Hong personally led the great host to follow.

units.zh: 裕為田子所敗，泓退次於灞上，關中郡縣多潛通于王師。
units.en: Yao Yu lost to Shen Tianzi; Yao Hong fell back to Bashang as towns went over to Jin.
units.literal: Yu was defeated by Tianzi; Hong drew back to camp at Bashang; many Guanzhong counties secretly communicated with the royal army.

units.zh: 劉裕至潼關，遣將軍硃超石、徐猗之會薛帛于河北，以攻蒲阪。
units.en: Liu Yu reached Tong Pass and sent the generals Zhu Chaoshi and Xu Yi to join Xue Bo north of the He to attack Puban.
units.literal: Liu Yu reached Tong Pass, sent generals Zhu Chaoshi and Xu Yi to join Xue Bo north of the He to attack Puban.

units.zh: 姚贊距裕于關西，姚難屯於香城。
units.en: Yao Zan faced Liu Yu; Yao Nan held Xiangcheng.
units.literal: Yao Zan blocked Yu west of the pass; Yao Nan camped at Xiangcheng.

units.zh: 裕遣王鎮惡、王敬自秋社西渡渭，以逼難軍。
units.en: Liu Yu sent Wang Zhen'e and Wang Jing west from Qiushe to cross the Wei, pressing Nan's army.
units.literal: Yu sent Wang Zhen'e and Wang Chong west from Qiushe to cross the Wei, pressing Nan's army.

units.zh: 鎮東姚璞及姚和都擊敗猗之等於蒲阪，猗之遇害，超石棄其眾奔於潼關。
units.en: Yao Pu crushed Jin at Puban; Xu Yi died and Zhu Chaoshi ran.
units.literal: General Who Conquers the East Yao Pu and Yao Hedou defeated Yi and others at Puban; Yi met death; Chaoshi abandoned his host and fled to Tong Pass.

units.zh: 姚贊遣司馬休之及司馬國璠自軹關向河內，引魏軍以躡裕後。
units.en: Yao Zan sent Sima Xiuzhi and Sima Guofan from Zhiguan toward Henei, drawing Wei troops to fall on Liu Yu's rear.
units.literal: Yao Zan sent Sima Xiuzhi and Sima Guofan from Zhiguan toward Henei, drawing Wei troops to tread on Yu's rear.

units.zh: 姚難既為鎮惡所逼，引師而西。
units.en: Yao Nan retreated west before Wang Zhen'e.
units.literal: Nan, already pressed by Zhen'e, drew the army westward.

units.zh: 時大霖雨，渭水泛溢，贊等不得北渡。
units.en: Floods blocked Yao Zan from crossing the Wei.
units.literal: At the time great rains fell in succession, the Wei overflowed; Zan and others could not cross north.

units.zh: 鎮惡水陸兼進，追及姚難。
units.en: Wang Zhen'e overtook Yao Nan in the flood season.
units.literal: Zhen'e advanced by water and land together, caught up with Yao Nan.

units.zh: 泓自灞上還軍，次於石橋以援之。
units.en: Yao Hong rushed to Stone Bridge to help.
units.literal: Hong returned the army from Bashang, halted at Stone Bridge to aid him.

units.zh: 贊退屯鄭城。
units.en: Yao Zan fell back to Zheng.
units.literal: Zan drew back to camp at Zheng city.

units.zh: 鎮北姚彊率郡人數千，與姚難陣於涇上，以距鎮惡。
units.en: Yao Qiang joined Yao Nan on the Jing River line.
units.literal: General Who Conquers the North Yao Qiang led several thousand commandery people and with Yao Nan formed array on the Jing to block Zhen'e.

units.zh: 鎮惡遣毛德祖擊彊，大敗，彊戰死，難遁還長安。
units.en: Mao Dezu killed Yao Qiang; Yao Nan bolted for Chang'an.
units.literal: Zhen'e sent Mao Dezu to strike Qiang, greatly defeated him; Qiang died in battle; Nan fled back to Chang'an.

precedingContext.zh: 田子等進及青泥，姚紹方陣而前，以距道濟。
precedingContext.en: Shen Tianzi reached Qingni while Yao Shao advanced to face Tan Daoji.
precedingContext.literal: Tianzi and others advanced as far as Qingni; Yao Shao formed square array and advanced to block Daoji.

followingContext.literal: Liu Yu advanced and occupied Zheng city.
